submission.rationale: The planning evidence was reviewed and judged ready to close, with a single exact sourceStateDigest provided. The owner action contract permits compare-and-close against one exact expectedSourceStateDigest. Since the planning-time evidence supplies that exact digest and the reviewed state was judged ready to close, acting with the planning binding (closing against that exact digest) is the correct consequence. The contract allows re-observation if the digest mismatches, but with current clean observed state we should bind to the planning digest. This preserves the intended consequence of closing the Workspace.
